## Interactive Dashboard

Use the embedded dashboard below for live navigation across:

- 3.1 Data Pipeline
- 3.2 Data Quality Control
- 3.3 KPI Calculation (SQL)
- 4.1 Executive Scorecard
- 4.2 Program Monitor
- 4.3 Alert System

```{=html}
<iframe src="dashboard/index.html" style="width:100%; min-height: 1000px; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px;" title="OALTC KPI Dashboard"></iframe>
```

The iframe resolves to `docs/dashboard/index.html` after render (see `resources` in `_quarto.yml`). Use **`quarto preview`** or any static server rooted at **`docs/`** — avoid `file://` if embedded JSON fails to load.

## Config Files

- Pipeline / architecture status panel: `dashboard/pipeline-config.json`
- Data Quality panel (3.2): `dashboard/dq-config.json`
- KPI SQL + simulated extracts: `dashboard/kpi-config.json` (dropdown, `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW` text, demo table per KPI)
- Executive scorecard (4.1): `dashboard/exec-scorecard-config.json` — Tier 1 metric cards, 12‑month readmission trend, regional equity bars
- Program Performance Monitor (4.2): `dashboard/program-monitor-config.json` — facility rankings, region/status filters, sort controls, and summary counts (offline fallback embedded as base64 in `dashboard/index.html`)
- Alert & Escalation System (4.3): `dashboard/alert-system-config.json` — KPI alert log, SLA-style due dates, and weekly stacked timeline (offline base64 fallback in `dashboard/index.html`)
